task: t4 (B4) — remove the array-typed `lines` parameter schema in mpd-hashline, with its own mount proof
defect: packages/mpd-hashline-plugin/src/index.ts declared `lines: { type: ["string","array"], items: { type: "string" } }` in the mpd_hashline_edit PARAMETER schema (and the committed dist carried the same bytes). The installed harness validator (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools assertSupportedJsonSchema) rejects type ARRAYS with `type must be a single type string (type arrays are not supported)` and a single violation aborts the whole plugin tree at load; it is latent only because this harness release asserts OUTPUT schemas, not parameters.
fix: lines: { oneOf: [{ type: "string" }, { type: "array", items: { type: "string" } }] } — the accepted union spelling, keeping both input shapes.
